---
title: "DS 340W: TB Catastrophic Cost Risk Classification & Funding Cut Simulation Test"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

## 1. Load Packages & Set Seed

```{r load-packages}
rm(list = ls())

# --- 1. LOAD PACKAGES & SET SEED ---
required_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse", "caret", "randomForest", "xgboost",
  "missForest", "smotefamily", "pROC", "countrycode"
)

for (pkg in required_packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

set.seed(340)
if (!dir.exists("results")) dir.create("results", recursive = TRUE)
```

## 2. Prepare GBD 2021 Burden Data (Repo 1)

```{r prep-repo1}
repo2_dir <- "Household_Economic_Burden/Inputs"

df_death      <- read.csv("data/death1.csv")
df_risk_death <- read.csv("data/risk_deathall.csv")
df_incidence  <- read.csv("data/incidence1.csv")
df_pop        <- read.csv("data/population1.csv")
df_le         <- read.csv("data/le.csv")

df_gdp <- read_csv(file.path(repo2_dir, "countries_included.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(iso3c = code, gdp_per_capita = GDPpc) %>%
  distinct()

death_clean <- df_death %>%
  filter(year == 2021, metric_name == "Rate") %>%
  select(location_id, location_name, sex_id, sex_name, age_id, age_name, cause_id, cause_name, Rate_tol_val = val)

risk_clean <- df_risk_death %>%
  filter(year == 2021, metric_name == "Rate") %>%
  select(location_id, sex_id, age_id, cause_id, Rate_r_val = val)

inc_clean <- df_incidence %>%
  filter(year == 2021, metric_name == "Rate") %>%
  select(location_id, sex_id, age_id, cause_id, Rate_in_val = val)

pop_clean <- df_pop %>%
  filter(year == 2021, metric_name == "Number") %>%
  select(location_id, sex_id, age_id, pop_val = val) %>%
  distinct()

le_clean <- df_le %>%
  filter(year == 2021, location_id == 1) %>%
  select(sex_id, age_id, LE = val) %>%
  distinct()

data_econ <- death_clean %>%
  left_join(risk_clean, by = c("location_id", "sex_id", "age_id", "cause_id")) %>%
  left_join(inc_clean,  by = c("location_id", "sex_id", "age_id", "cause_id")) %>%
  left_join(pop_clean,  by = c("location_id", "sex_id", "age_id")) %>%
  left_join(le_clean,   by = c("sex_id", "age_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    iso3c = countrycode(location_name, origin = "country.name", destination = "iso3c", warn = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  left_join(df_gdp, by = "iso3c") %>%
  mutate(
    gdp_per_capita = coalesce(gdp_per_capita, 10000),
    Rate_r_val     = coalesce(Rate_r_val, 0),
    Rate_in_val    = coalesce(Rate_in_val, 0),
    LE             = coalesce(LE, 30),
    AM_val         = pmax(Rate_tol_val - Rate_r_val, 0),
    CFR_est        = ifelse(Rate_in_val > 0, Rate_tol_val / Rate_in_val, 0),
    AM_Deaths_Num  = (AM_val / 100000) * pop_val,
  )

write_csv(data_econ, "results/repo1_data_econ.csv")
cat("Saved results/repo1_data_econ.csv with", nrow(data_econ), "rows.\n")
```

## 3. Integrate Repo 1 + Repo 2 + Paper 3 (WHO / World Bank)

```{r integrate-real-data}
# --- 3. INTEGRATE REPO 1 + REPO 2 + PAPER 3 (data/wdi_data.csv) ---
build_real_integrated_data <- function(
    repo1_path  = "results/repo1_data_econ.csv",
    repo2_dir   = "Household_Economic_Burden/Inputs",
    paper3_path = "data/wdi_data.csv"
) {
  
  # A1. Load Repo 2 PPP GDP, True Income Group (LIC/LMIC/UMIC) & Country Quintile Shares
  repo2_meta <- read_csv(file.path(repo2_dir, "global_dist_scen_usaid_gf.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(
      iso3c = code,
      income_level = income,
      gdp_pc_ppp,
      poorest_share, poorer_share, middle_share, richer_share, richest_share
    ) %>%
    distinct(iso3c, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  # A2. Load Repo 2 Country-Specific Funding Cut Multipliers (6 Scenarios)
  funding_cuts <- read_csv(file.path(repo2_dir, "funding_scenario_values.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    rename(iso3c = code) %>%
    distinct(iso3c, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  # A3. Load 5 Wealth Quintile Costs (in International PPP $)
  quintiles <- c("poorest", "poorer", "middle", "richer", "richest")
  
  quintile_costs <- map_dfr(seq_along(quintiles), function(q_idx) {
    q <- quintiles[q_idx]
    
    dm  <- read_csv(file.path(repo2_dir, paste0("cost_dm_", q, "_pred_sets.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE)
    nm  <- read_csv(file.path(repo2_dir, paste0("cost_nm_", q, "_pred_sets.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE)
    ind <- read_csv(file.path(repo2_dir, paste0("cost_ind_", q, "_pred_sets.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    tibble(
      iso3c           = dm$iso3,
      income_quintile = q_idx,
      quintile_label  = q,
      mean_dm_cost    = rowMeans(select(dm, starts_with("cost_dm_")), na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_nm_cost    = rowMeans(select(nm, starts_with("cost_nm_")), na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_ind_cost   = rowMeans(select(ind, starts_with("cost_ind_")), na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
      mutate(base_tb_cost = mean_dm_cost + mean_nm_cost + mean_ind_cost)
  })
  
  repo2_merged <- repo2_meta %>%
    inner_join(quintile_costs, by = "iso3c") %>%
    left_join(funding_cuts, by = "iso3c") %>%
    mutate(
      across(starts_with("scen_"), ~ coalesce(., 0)),
      quintile_share = case_when(
        income_quintile == 1 ~ poorest_share,
        income_quintile == 2 ~ poorer_share,
        income_quintile == 3 ~ middle_share,
        income_quintile == 4 ~ richer_share,
        income_quintile == 5 ~ richest_share
      ),
      # Both annual_income and tb_cost are now in matching International PPP $
      annual_income = gdp_pc_ppp * (quintile_share * 5)
    )
  
  # B. Load Repo 1: GBD 2021 Age, Sex & Drug-Resistance Strata
  repo1 <- read_csv(repo1_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      iso3c = if ("iso3c" %in% names(.)) iso3c else countrycode(location_name, origin = "country.name", destination = "iso3c", warn = FALSE),
      patient_age = case_when(
        age_id == 1  ~ 2,  age_id == 6  ~ 7,  age_id == 7  ~ 12,
        age_id == 8  ~ 17, age_id == 9  ~ 22, age_id == 10 ~ 27,
        age_id == 11 ~ 32, age_id == 12 ~ 37, age_id == 13 ~ 42,
        age_id == 14 ~ 47, age_id == 15 ~ 52, age_id == 16 ~ 57,
        age_id == 17 ~ 62, age_id == 18 ~ 67, age_id == 19 ~ 72,
        TRUE ~ 35
      ),
      patient_sex = ifelse(sex_id == 1, 1, 0),
      drug_resistance_type = case_when(
        cause_id == 934 ~ 0, # DS-TB
        cause_id == 946 ~ 1, # MDR-TB
        cause_id == 947 ~ 2, # XDR-TB
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(iso3c), !is.na(drug_resistance_type))
  
  mdr_country <- repo1 %>%
    filter(drug_resistance_type == 1) %>%
    group_by(iso3c) %>%
    summarise(mdr_tb_incidence = mean(Rate_in_val, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  country_burden <- repo1 %>%
    group_by(iso3c) %>%
    summarise(
      gbd_life_expectancy = mean(LE, na.rm = TRUE),
      amenable_mort_rate  = mean(AM_val, na.rm = TRUE),
      cfr_estimate        = mean(CFR_est, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # C. Load Paper 3 (data/wdi_data.csv)
  paper3_raw <- read_csv(paper3_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      iso3c = countrycode(Countries, origin = "country.name", destination = "iso3c", warn = FALSE)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(iso3c), Year <= 2021) %>%
    arrange(iso3c, Year)
  
  paper3_2021 <- paper3_raw %>%
    group_by(iso3c) %>%
    mutate(
      y14_clean = ifelse(Year >= 2020, NA_real_, na_if(y14, 0)),
      y15_clean = na_if(y15, 0),
      y17_clean = na_if(y17, 0),
      y22_clean = na_if(y22, 0)
    ) %>%
    fill(y14_clean, y15_clean, y17_clean, y22_clean, .direction = "down") %>%
    filter(Year == 2021) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    transmute(
      iso3c,
      hiv_tb_rate        = x3,
      who_mdr_cases      = y8,
      who_mdr_rate       = ifelse(!is.na(y17_clean) & y17_clean > 0, (y8 / y17_clean) * 1e5, NA_real_),
      hypertension_prev  = coalesce(y14_clean, y14),
      cigarette_price    = coalesce(y15_clean, 0),
      gov_health_exp_pct = coalesce(y22_clean, 5.5),
      life_expectancy    = na_if(y23, 0),
      electricity_access = na_if(y26, 0),
      air_pollution      = na_if(y31, 0)
    ) %>%
    distinct(iso3c, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  # D. Merge All Three Datasets & Define Target Variable
  integrated_df <- repo2_merged %>%
    inner_join(
      repo1 %>% select(iso3c, patient_age, patient_sex, drug_resistance_type, Rate_in_val),
      by = "iso3c",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    left_join(mdr_country, by = "iso3c") %>%
    left_join(country_burden, by = "iso3c") %>%
    left_join(paper3_2021, by = "iso3c") %>%
    mutate(
      life_expectancy            = coalesce(life_expectancy, gbd_life_expectancy),
      gdp_per_capita             = gdp_pc_ppp,
      # Total health spending per capita (domestic gov share from y22 + external donor buffer)
      health_spending_per_capita = gdp_pc_ppp * (gov_health_exp_pct / 100),
      income_group               = case_when(
        income_level == "LIC"  ~ "Low-Income (LIC)",
        income_level == "LMIC" ~ "Lower-Middle-Income (LMIC)",
        income_level == "UMIC" ~ "Upper-Middle-Income (UMIC)",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      # Working-age (15-64) patients incur higher indirect wage losses (Paper 2)
      working_age_mult           = ifelse(patient_age >= 15 & patient_age <= 64, 1.25, 0.65),
      adj_base_cost              = mean_dm_cost + mean_nm_cost + (mean_ind_cost * working_age_mult),
      tb_cost = case_when(
        drug_resistance_type == 1 ~ adj_base_cost * 2.5,
        drug_resistance_type == 2 ~ adj_base_cost * 4.0,
        TRUE ~ adj_base_cost
      ),
      is_catastrophic_cost = ifelse((tb_cost / annual_income) > 0.20, 1, 0)
    ) %>%
    slice_sample(n = 5000, weight_by = pmax(Rate_in_val, 0.01), replace = FALSE)
  
  return(integrated_df)
}

df_raw <- build_real_integrated_data()
cat("Merged Dataset Dimensions:", nrow(df_raw), "rows x", ncol(df_raw), "columns\n")
cat("Baseline Catastrophic Cost Rate:", round(mean(df_raw$is_catastrophic_cost) * 100, 2), "%\n")
```

## 4. Preprocessing & Outlier Pipeline

```{r preprocessing}
feature_cols <- c(
  "patient_age", "patient_sex", "drug_resistance_type", "income_quintile",
  "gdp_per_capita", "health_spending_per_capita", "mdr_tb_incidence",
  "who_mdr_rate", "hiv_tb_rate", "life_expectancy", "amenable_mort_rate",
  "cfr_estimate", "air_pollution", "cigarette_price", "hypertension_prev",
  "electricity_access"
)

skewed_cols <- c(
  "gdp_per_capita", "health_spending_per_capita", "mdr_tb_incidence",
  "who_mdr_rate", "hiv_tb_rate", "amenable_mort_rate", "air_pollution"
)

target_col <- "is_catastrophic_cost"

df_model_input <- df_raw %>%
  select(all_of(c(feature_cols, target_col))) %>%
  as.data.frame()
df_model_input[[target_col]] <- as.factor(df_model_input[[target_col]])

imp_out <- missForest(df_model_input, verbose = FALSE)
df_imputed <- imp_out$ximp

df_logged <- df_imputed
for (col in skewed_cols) {
  df_logged[[col]] <- log1p(pmax(df_logged[[col]], 0))
}

pca_res    <- prcomp(df_logged[, skewed_cols], scale. = TRUE)
pca_scores <- pca_res$x[, 1:2]
mahal_dist <- mahalanobis(pca_scores, colMeans(pca_scores), cov(pca_scores))
keep_rows  <- mahal_dist < qchisq(0.999, df = 2)

df_filtered   <- df_logged[keep_rows, ]
meta_filtered <- df_raw[keep_rows, c(
  "iso3c", "income_group", "income_quintile",
  "scen_usaid", "scen_usaid_USA_expcut", "scen_usaid_USA",
  "scen_usaid_gf_expcut_noNGO", "scen_usaid_gf"
)]

cat("Rows retained after Mahalanobis outlier filtering:", nrow(df_filtered), "\n")

set.seed(340)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(df_filtered[[target_col]], p = 0.70, list = FALSE)
train_raw <- df_filtered[train_idx, ]
temp_raw  <- df_filtered[-train_idx, ]

val_idx  <- createDataPartition(temp_raw[[target_col]], p = 1/3, list = FALSE)
val_raw  <- temp_raw[val_idx, ]
test_raw <- temp_raw[-val_idx, ]

scaler_pipeline <- preProcess(train_raw[, feature_cols], method = c("center", "scale"))

train_scaled <- predict(scaler_pipeline, train_raw[, feature_cols])
val_scaled   <- predict(scaler_pipeline, val_raw[, feature_cols])
test_scaled  <- predict(scaler_pipeline, test_raw[, feature_cols])

train_scaled[[target_col]] <- train_raw[[target_col]]
val_scaled[[target_col]]   <- val_raw[[target_col]]
test_scaled[[target_col]]  <- test_raw[[target_col]]

smote_out <- SMOTE(
  X = train_scaled[, feature_cols],
  target = as.numeric(as.character(train_scaled[[target_col]]))
)
train_balanced <- smote_out$data
colnames(train_balanced)[ncol(train_balanced)] <- target_col
train_balanced[[target_col]] <- as.factor(train_balanced[[target_col]])

cat("Balanced Training Set Size after SMOTE:", nrow(train_balanced), "rows\n")
```

## 5. Model Training, 10-Fold Cross-Validation & SHAP
```{r modeling}
# --- 5. MODEL TRAINING, 10-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION & SHAP ---
baseline_glm <- glm(
  is_catastrophic_cost ~ income_quintile + gdp_per_capita,
  data = train_balanced,
  family = binomial()
)

train_rf_df <- train_balanced
train_rf_df$target_factor <- factor(ifelse(train_rf_df[[target_col]] == "1", "Yes", "No"))

cv_ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 10,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary
)

rf_cv_model <- train(
  x = train_rf_df[, feature_cols],
  y = train_rf_df$target_factor,
  method = "rf",
  metric = "ROC",
  trControl = cv_ctrl,
  ntree = 300
)

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = as.matrix(train_balanced[, feature_cols]),
  label = as.numeric(as.character(train_balanced[[target_col]]))
)
dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = as.matrix(test_scaled[, feature_cols]),
  label = as.numeric(as.character(test_scaled[[target_col]]))
)

xgb_params <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "auc",
  max_depth = 6,
  eta = 0.05
)

final_xgb <- xgb.train(
  params = xgb_params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 300,
  verbose = 0
)

y_true <- as.numeric(as.character(test_scaled[[target_col]]))

pred_base <- predict(baseline_glm, newdata = test_scaled, type = "response")
pred_rf   <- predict(rf_cv_model,  newdata = test_scaled[, feature_cols], type = "prob")[, "Yes"]
pred_xgb  <- predict(final_xgb,    newdata = dtest)

calc_metrics <- function(probs, actual, model_name) {
  preds <- ifelse(probs > 0.5, 1, 0)
  cm <- confusionMatrix(factor(preds, levels = c(0, 1)), factor(actual, levels = c(0, 1)), positive = "1")
  auc_val  <- as.numeric(auc(roc(actual, probs, quiet = TRUE)))
  rmse_val <- sqrt(mean((actual - probs)^2))
  
  tibble(
    Model    = model_name,
    Accuracy = round(cm$overall["Accuracy"], 4),
    Recall   = round(cm$byClass["Recall"], 4),
    F1_Score = round(cm$byClass["F1"], 4),
    AUC_ROC  = round(auc_val, 4),
    RMSE     = round(rmse_val, 4)
  )
}

results_table <- bind_rows(
  calc_metrics(pred_base, y_true, "Baseline (Income + GDP Only)"),
  calc_metrics(pred_rf,   y_true, "Random Forest (10-Fold CV)"),
  calc_metrics(pred_xgb,  y_true, "XGBoost Classifier")
)

print(results_table)

xgb.plot.shap.summary(
  data = as.matrix(test_scaled[, feature_cols]),
  model = final_xgb
) +
labs(
    x = "SHAP Value (Impact on Model Prediction)",
    y = "Predictor Variables",
    color = "Feature Value",
    top_n=16
  )

```

## 6. Six Funding-Cut Scenarios (Overall & By Country Income Group)
```{r scenarios}
# --- 6. SIX FUNDING-CUT SCENARIOS (COUNTRY-SPECIFIC SHOCKS BY INCOME GROUP) ---
apply_funding_cut_scenarios <- function(logged_dataframe, meta_df, pre_process_model, final_classifier) {
  
  scenario_cols <- c(
    "Scenario 0: Baseline (No Cut)"                       = "baseline",
    "Scenario 1: USAID Termination (scen_usaid)"          = "scen_usaid",
    "Scenario 2: USAID + US Red. GF (scen_usaid_USA_exp)" = "scen_usaid_USA_expcut",
    "Scenario 3: USAID + US Term. GF (scen_usaid_USA)"    = "scen_usaid_USA",
    "Scenario 4: USAID + Red. GF (scen_usaid_gf_exp)"     = "scen_usaid_gf_expcut_noNGO",
    "Scenario 5: Full External Cut (scen_usaid_gf)"       = "scen_usaid_gf"
  )
  
  map_dfr(names(scenario_cols), function(scen_name) {
    col_key <- scenario_cols[[scen_name]]
    
    # Extract each country's exact funding cut share (0 for baseline)
    cut_share <- if (col_key == "baseline") rep(0, nrow(meta_df)) else meta_df[[col_key]]
    
    simulated_df <- logged_dataframe
    for (col in skewed_cols) {
      simulated_df[[col]] <- expm1(simulated_df[[col]])
    }
    
    # Apply country-specific funding cut to health spending, effective economic capacity, and TB burden
  simulated_df$health_spending_per_capita <- simulated_df$health_spending_per_capita * (1 - cut_share)
  simulated_df$gdp_per_capita             <- simulated_df$gdp_per_capita * (1 - 0.25 * cut_share)
  simulated_df$mdr_tb_incidence           <- simulated_df$mdr_tb_incidence * (1 + 0.50 * cut_share)
  simulated_df$who_mdr_rate               <- simulated_df$who_mdr_rate * (1 + 0.50 * cut_share)
  simulated_df$hiv_tb_rate                <- simulated_df$hiv_tb_rate * (1 + 0.40 * cut_share)

    
    for (col in skewed_cols) {
      simulated_df[[col]] <- log1p(simulated_df[[col]])
    }
    
    sim_scaled <- predict(pre_process_model, simulated_df[, feature_cols])
    preds <- predict(final_classifier, as.matrix(sim_scaled))
    
    bind_cols(meta_df, tibble(pred_prob = preds, high_risk = ifelse(preds > 0.5, 1, 0))) %>%
      group_by(income_group) %>%
      summarise(
        Scenario                      = scen_name,
        Projected_High_Risk_Share_Pct = round(mean(high_risk) * 100, 2),
        Mean_Predicted_Probability    = round(mean(pred_prob) * 100, 2),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }) %>%
    select(Scenario, income_group, Projected_High_Risk_Share_Pct, Mean_Predicted_Probability)
}

scenario_results <- apply_funding_cut_scenarios(df_filtered, meta_filtered, scaler_pipeline, final_xgb)
print(scenario_results, n = 20)
```
